title: A gang stole £14,244 to buy AI chatbot credits. His bank spotted the first charge and let the rest happen.
excerpt: Fraudsters used a Metro Bank customer's card to buy £14,244 of Claude credits. The bank flagged the first charge, then let more than £14,000 more through.
content_html:
A businessman in Sussex watched £14,244 drain out of his Metro Bank account. The money went on credits for Claude, the AI chatbot he already paid to use. Two things failed at once. Criminals had turned a chatbot into a way to cash out stolen cards. And his bank spotted the first fraudulent charge, warned him, then let more than £14,000 more go through.

Zoli Rutter had been paying about £15 a month for Claude for a few months, he told Guardian Money. He used it to track and analyse business invoices. The fraudsters used the Metro debit card linked to his Anthropic account to buy credits on the platform.

Caught, then waved through

On 19 June, Metro spotted a suspicious transaction for £90.90. It texted Rutter to ask whether he had authorised it. He texted back to say he had not. He then got another message: Metro would freeze his account. In the event, the bank blocked only that one transaction, not the account.

The fraudulent charges kept coming, each between £90 and £200. Metro blocked some and missed many. It froze the card the day after the scam began, but by then more than £14,000 had gone. The bank blamed the “complex nature of the fraud.” It had processed some payments, it said, before it could block the card fully.

A chatbot as a cash register

The mechanics are what make this new. A coordinated gang used Rutter’s card details to buy Claude credits, according to Anthropic. The company said it had no evidence the details came from its own systems. It had also banned the user behind the fraud. Anyone wrongly charged should contact its support, it added, and it will refund the charges.

It was not a one-off. In May, a US Claude user told Guardian Money that fraudsters had bought gift cards for the chatbot with his financial details. Others posted similar accounts on Reddit. AI credits are becoming a target in their own right. It is part of a wider AI-era fraud economy that banks are racing to keep up with.

Who pays

The refund became a tangle. After Guardian Money got in touch, Metro temporarily refunded Rutter while it chased a chargeback from Anthropic. Anthropic has since refunded him directly, so the bank will now claw back its temporary payment. Metro told Rutter in a letter that he had not received the service it expects. It offered him £300 in compensation.

Rutter says he intends to complain to the Financial Ombudsman Service. Metro says it has taken steps to prevent delays in blocking cards in future.

The case lands in a busy month for Claude. Last week the FCA appeared to endorse the chatbot, agreeing to give firms in its high-tech sandbox access to it. This week it emerged that some people’s Claude conversations were publicly visible online. Anthropic has separately moved to verify who its users are.

The underlying problem is simpler than any of it. As more people save a card to pay for AI, that card becomes a target. The safeguards on both sides are still catching up.

content_html_zh:
苏塞克斯的一位商人亲眼目睹 14,244 英镑从他的大都会银行账户中流失。 这笔钱转入了克劳德（Claude）的账户，他已经付费使用了人工智能聊天机器人。 有两件事同时失败了。 犯罪分子将聊天机器人变成了兑现被盗卡的一种方式。 他的银行发现了第一笔欺诈指控，警告他，然后又放行了超过 14,000 英镑。

佐利·鲁特 (Zoli Rutter) 告诉《卫报》财经频道，几个月来，佐利·鲁特 (Zoli Rutter) 每月为克劳德支付约 15 英镑。 他用它来跟踪和分析商业发票。 诈骗者使用与其 Anthropic 账户关联的 Metro 借记卡在该平台上购买积分。

被抓住，然后挥手过去

6 月 19 日，Metro 发现了一笔 90.90 英镑的可疑交易。 它给拉特发短信询问他是否已授权。 他回短信说他没有。 随后他又收到一条消息：Metro将冻结他的账户。 结果，银行只冻结了一笔交易，而不是账户。

欺诈指控不断出现，每项金额在 90 至 200 英镑之间。 地铁阻挡了一些，错过了许多。 诈骗开始后的第二天，该银行就冻结了该卡，但当时已有超过 14,000 英镑被盗。 该银行指责“欺诈行为的复杂性”。 它表示，在完全冻结该卡之前，它已经处理了一些付款。

聊天机器人作为收银机

机制让这一切焕然一新。 据 Anthropic 称，一个协调一致的团伙利用鲁特的信用卡详细信息购买了克劳德的积分。 该公司表示，没有证据表明这些细节来自其自己的系统。 它还禁止了欺诈背后的用户。 它补充说，任何被错误收费的人都应该联系其支持人员，并且将退还费用。

这不是一次性的。 今年 5 月，一位美国 Claude 用户告诉 Guardian Money，诈骗者用他的财务详细信息为聊天机器人购买了礼品卡。 其他人也在 Reddit 上发布了类似的账户。 人工智能积分本身正在成为一个目标。 这是银行竞相跟上的更广泛的人工智能时代欺诈经济的一部分。

谁付钱

退款成了一个纠结。 Guardian Money 联系后，Metro 暂时向 Rutter 退款，同时追讨 Anthropic 的退款。 Anthropic 已直接退款给他，因此银行现在将收回其临时付款。 Metro 在一封信中告诉 Rutter，他没有得到预期的服务。 它向他提供了 300 英镑的赔偿。

鲁特表示，他打算向金融监察员服务机构投诉。 Metro表示，已采取措施防止未来卡卡延误。

此案发生在克劳德忙碌的一个月里。 上周，FCA 似乎认可了这款聊天机器人，同意让其高科技沙箱中的公司访问它。 本周有消息称，一些人与克劳德的对话在网上公开可见。 Anthropic 已单独采取行动来验证其用户是谁。

根本问题比任何一个问题都简单。 随着越来越多的人存一张卡来支付人工智能费用，该卡就成为了目标。 双方的保障措施仍在迎头赶上。
